You've discovered a letter in the ruined campsite where you found your mangled Thorn. The sender purports to be the legendary Shin Malphur, a supposed do-gooder with a complex approach to doing good. title: A Map Asunder
text:
To your dismay, the chest did not contain a complete map. Instead, you have a fragment of a larger whole, along with a cryptic note. Whoever hid this Rocket Launcher took great pains to keep it safe.

Unravel the clues to find and decode the remaining pieces.

title: A Masked Treasure
text: Use the Cipher Decoder on a cache in the Haunted Forest.

title: A Lost Relic
text:
You've pulled a new timelost frame out of the shattered timelines within the Sundial. Although you can't identify the weapon yourself, Saint-14 thinks he can help you discover its origin.

Bring the frame to Saint-14 in the Tower Hangar.

title: A Message of Solidarity
text:
Aunor is one of the Hidden, a covert group of Guardians who gather sensitive intelligence. You've heard rumors that they're embedded on just about every active Vanguard front, including the Tower. With your message in hand, you begin to look around, hoping to find one of them. Maybe they can get your message to Aunor.

Find the Hidden agent in the Tower Hangar to drop off your message.

title: A Missing Link
text:
The obelisk is fully functioning. All that's left is to link it to the Sundial by strengthening its power here on the Shore.

Activate the Tangled Shore Obelisk's Sundial link.

title: A March of Fire
text: Head to Venus in search of the Sunbreakers, a mercenary clan of Titans.  Complete mission "A March of Fire."

title: A+ Master
text: Achieve performance grade A+ or better on Master difficulty activities.

title: An Enthusiastic Gun
text: Bring the frame to the Gunsmith.

title: A Mind Forever Changing
text: You can find this rare emblem only once you reach a certain score in the Nightfall "The Inverted Spire."

title: A Melted Hunk of Metal
text:
Despite the burn damage, you recognize this weapon as a Thorn, a legendary weapon capable of severing Guardians from the Light. The Shadows of Yor, followers of an infamous Guardian-killer, are well-known for carrying Thorns. This one is broken, but you think it may be possible to fix it. A reputable (and discreet) gunsmith would know where to start.

Bring the ruined Thorn to Banshee-44 in the Tower.

title: A Modest Request
text: Accept a Revelry Bounty from Eva Levante.

title: A Mysterious Decryption Device
text:
The mysterious box contained an artifact that seems to be a decryption device.

Return to Ada-1 and show her what you've found.

Destinations marked with a yellow "star" icon have active challenges. Hover over the icon to see the details associated with the challenges.

Equip your Guardian Games class item. Then collect Laurels by defeating minibosses or lesser combatants with your grenades, melee attacks, or Supers.

You have a chance to earn bonus progress when you pick up Laurels that match your class. The new Guardian Games strike playlist is a great place to start!

title: A Reasonable Price
text:
Spider is willing to stop trading with the Drifter… for the right price. He's asking for quite a lot of Glimmer. You're not happy about the arrangement, nor do you trust Spider, but after a quick consultation with Ghost, you both agree it's likely worth it. Spider does keep his word, after all.

Pay off Spider.

title: Legacy: A Rising Chorus: Act II
text:
Your Radiolite Sampler can extract and isolate unique segments of mutated radiolaria within discovered nodes of radiolite.

Use your Radiolite Sampler to extract Vex code mutations from Radiolite Incubators within Episode: Echoes activities. Extracting from Iridescent Incubators provides the greatest chance to find the code mutations.

Failsafe will need these resources to upgrade her H.E.L.M. equipment and add more research bays before she can start her analysis of the Hydra tail obtained from Battleground: Delve.

title: Act III: Crossed Blades
text:
"My proud sister reduced to this," Oryx laughs.

He is simultaneously pleased by the triumph of his presumptive heir and disappointed by the defeat of his sister.

"My sisters are now hollow. Blunted…"

Oryx considers his role in what has become of the Hive pantheon.

"So, you have forestalled Xivu Arath. Her ritual scatters. This throne world and its chains stand."

text:

title: Legacy: Cryptic Quatrains II

I shivered with terror at what they might wield

title: Legacy: Cryptic Quatrains II

I fancied I noticed, beyond broken sphere,
 
A place that was safe for me treasure and I

A pack for Guardians who wish the Dawning would never end.

Contains 3 Winterdrift Engrams, 5 Aniline Shock shaders, and 1 Gleaming Boon of the Vanguard.

title: Dawning's Gift Schematic: Cayde
text:
Cayde made many friends during the Red War, but he's grown especially fond of a certain someone. Complete the following objectives:

- Defeat Hive Wizards for pieces of their brittle capes
- Collect Dusklight from the EDZ to craft a perfect replica

title: Dawning's Gift Schematic: Amanda
text:
Life in the Hangar can get a bit messy, and Amanda doesn't often take breaks to deal with it. Complete the following objectives:

- Defeat enemies on Nessus to collect tiny synthetic plant fibers
- Collect Dusklight from the EDZ to pulverize into thread

title: Dawning's Gift Schematic: Banshee
text:
The Gunsmith has been rebooted so many times that he sometimes has trouble keeping things straight. Complete the following objectives:

- Defeat Vex Hobgoblins to collect their metal for melting down
- Collect Datalattice from Nessus for Exo-related modifications

title: Dawning's Gift Schematic: Asher
text:
It gets cold on Io, but Asher's often too busy to do anything about it. Complete the following objectives:

- Defeat enemies on Titan to harvest Golden Age microfibers
- Collect Phaseglass Spires on Io for temperature-regulating stitching

title: Dawning's Gift Schematic: Hawthorne
text:
Hawthorne and her feathered friend have been through a lot over the years. Complete the following objectives:

- Defeat enemies on Nessus to collect organosynthetic construction residue
- Collect Alkane Spores from Titan to catalyze it into a new form

title: Dawning's Gift Schematic: Ikora
text:
Ikora is looking for something to augment her new outlook on life. Complete the following objectives:

- Defeat Hive Thrall to harvest their leathery hides
- Collect Datalattice from Nessus to imbue the receptacle with Golden Age information

title: Dawning's Gift Schematic: Lord Shaxx
text:
The Crucible Lord's booming voice can be heard all over the Tower. It must get tiring. Complete the following objectives:

- Collect Phaseglass from Io to melt down
- Defeat Servitors to harvest their unrefined Ether

title: Dawning's Gift Schematic: Devrim
text:
Devrim is ready for a change from one of his usual vices. Complete the following objectives:

- Defeat Vex Fanatics for their milky radiolarian fluid
- Collect Alkane from Titan to shake on top

title: Dawning's Gift Schematic: Rahool
text:
Rahool could use a gift equal to what he's given Humanity over the years. Complete the following objectives:

- Collect engrams for raw materials
- Defeat Taken enemies to capture their shadowy essence

title: Dawning's Gift Schematic: Zavala
text:
Zavala needs something to help him relieve the stress of having lost the City to the Red Legion. Complete the following objectives:

- Defeat Red Legion enemies to synthesize their armor
- Collect Phaseglass from Io to enable dynamic resizing of bonded solids

title: Dawning's Gift Schematic: Sloane
text:
The relentless spray of Titan's methane ocean can be exhausting for its defenders. Complete the following objectives:

- Defeat Hive Acolytes to collect their water-resistant skin
- Collect Datalattice from Nessus to create pseudo-organic algorithms

title: Dawning's Gift: Shaxx
text: Bake Vanilla Blades in Eva's Holiday Oven, and deliver them to Lord Shaxx in the Tower Courtyard.

title: Dawning Memento

A rare curio obtained from The Dawning.

When inserted into a Shaped or Enhanced weapon, this Memento will grant the weapon additional vanity options.

You may store only three of these Mementos at a time.

title: EDZ Treasure Map
text: "Listen, I feel bad making you go after my stuff, so last night I snuck down to the EDZ. Sh-sh-sh, don't tell Zavala! Anyway, I got the cache, then got a tiny bit turned around and ended up in a Cabal base. You know how that is. The dogs and all. Had to stash the goods quickly and get out. So… can you go get it?" -Cayde-6

title: EDZ Treasure Map
text: "So I took off edging the cliff, Golden Gun down to one shot. Left a lot behind cliffside. Bad day." -Cayde-6

title: EDZ Token
text: This item serves no purpose and can be safely dismantled.

title: EDZ Treasure Map
text: "So after a full day of pulling loot out of the Fallen's hands, I thought I would just cool my engines down by that old river, but as soon as I cached it all up down there, a Servitor shows up." -Cayde-6

title: EDZ Treasure Map
text: "You do much driving? Me neither. But I used to spend nights hiding out near this truck just teetering on a ledge, just waiting for the day some dumb Dreg would send it over the ledge. That day never came." -Cayde-6

title: EDZ Treasure Map
text: "This place is full of old containers. Don't bother raiding them all-I already did. They're all filled with shoes. Mountains of Golden Age footwear, and not a thing in my size." -Cayde-6

title: EDZ Treasure Map
text: "You know, I used to think if it's marked a dead zone, it's my kind of place. Vanguard cured me of that, but I left plenty behind there back in the day. Third-floor balcony, above the alley.  Loved that spot…. Hope the Fallen haven't got to it." -Cayde-6

title: EDZ Treasure Map
text: "So once you get up there, don't be afraid to strut it on the catwalk. We both know the importance of looking good." -Cayde-6

title: EDZ Treasure Map
text: "New lead from Hawthorne. Not really much to go on, something about a fan. I know I must have a lot of them, so if you see one down in the EDZ, maybe ask them?" -Cayde-6

title: EDZ Treasure Map
text: "Stashed plenty of loot up at the old mill in the EDZ. To scare the Dregs off, I'd throw on some old Festival of the Lost masks and make 'em think the place was haunted." -Cayde-6

title: EDZ Treasure Map
text: "OK, all I can give you to go on in this one is… it's high up. So… look up, I guess? Don't look at me like that, I'm doing my best." -Cayde-6

title: EDZ Treasure Map
text: "Good news: I remember exactly where one of my old EDZ caches is. Bad news: those parts are Taken territory now. So I guess the question is: how bad d'you want it?"

title: EDZ Treasure Map
text: "I used to have this old lookout. Scoped out my first FWC bunker there. Just like the Cabal to plop that eyesore of a base right on top of a piece of dark age nostalgia. Do me a favor, if you make it up there: snipe a few rhinos for me." -Cayde-6

title: EDZ Treasure Map
text: "They thought they had me dead-to-sights… backing me down this cliff. But I could see some fellow Hunters sparrowing in from the highway. Classic. So I sparked up a little Golden Gun and bought my guys some time.  I know I dropped something good in that one." -Cayde-6

title: EDZ Treasure Map
text: "I tell you what. You get to work cleaning out the angry spider-pirates and space-rhinos, and I give you the deed to this little cabin I won from Ren. With a little work, could become a nice little getaway." -Cayde-6

title: EDZ Treasure Map
text: "I've been all around this system, seen all sorts of transports, but nothing with the resiliency of this old Golden Age rustbucket I found in the EDZ. Used it as a grab-and-go spot for years." -Cayde-6

title: EVENT INFO
text:
• Earn Silver Leaves from completing activities throughout the game with Candescent armor equipped. Wearing a full set of Candescent armor rewards the most Silver Leaves. Launch into the Bonfire Bash and stoke the bonfire to turn Silver Leaves into Silver Ash. The more you stoke the bonfire, the more Silver Leaves can be transformed into Silver Ash, and the more Solstice armor and weapons are rewarded.

• Silver Ash can be used on Candescent armor to apply Glowing Embers, then Shining Embers, then Stat Sparks, all of which reroll stats for that armor piece.

• Complete Event Challenges, located on the Quest screen, to acquire Kindling, which can be applied to Candescent armor. Doing so grants access to better Embers and stat-roll choices from Sparks.

• Glows can be acquired for Candescent armor by fully rekindling an armor piece by applying Kindling.

• Solstice reward packages, which may contain Masterwork materials, can be purchased from Eva using Silver Ash.

Gather Fated Ciphers and materials to focus into Kepler gear.

title: Hellas Basin Treasure Map
text: "Snow. It's cold, it's wet, and it's generally pretty great to throw at people. But you know what else it's good for? Hiding things. I wonder where I can get some white paint around here…" -Cayde-6

title: Hellas Basin Scanner

title: Hellas Basin Treasure Map
text: "Wherever it is, you're gonna want to bring a coat, 'cause it sounds real cold. My horn was frozen like a popsicle, if you could imagine. When you find it, you're in for a splendid view. But yeah, bring a coat." -Cayde-6

title: Hellas Basin Treasure Map
text: "Bray's an interesting place. I have a complicated relationship with it, given my past and all. But I've gotta admit, they've built some dang impressive stuff for the whole system. The Golden Age must have been a wild time to be alive." -Cayde-6

title: Hellas Basin Treasure Map
text: "Have you ever heard of a Warsat doing something OTHER than crashing? Don't get me wrong, I appreciate the service of our Warsats, but at a certain point you have to ask: what do they do?" -Cayde-6

title: Hellas Basin Treasure Map
text: "I'm not an engineer, but I'd bet half my stash on the fact that no one has any idea what any of this stuff actually does. I think these guys just like how all these nooks and hidey-holes look." -Cayde-6

title: Hellas Basin Treasure Map
text: "Y'know, I'd tell you to look for the power generator, but I'll be honest-all this computer-y stuff? Looks the same to me. This one was pretty… small. I guess we all look pretty small standing next to Rasputin, though." -Cayde-6

title: Hellas Basin Treasure Map
text: "Hiding treasure is an art. And there are a lot of different kinds of art, right? This would be an art piece that's an ironic metacommentary about art, if that makes sense. Yeah, that totally doesn't make sense." -Cayde-6

title: Hellas Basin Treasure Map
text: "Have you ever actually crawled through an air duct? Not nearly as easy as it looks. I mean, I'm good at it, but I'm…well, me. All I'm saying is the trick is in angling your shoulders. And not having a big lunch." -Cayde-6

title: Hellas Basin Treasure Map
text: "Let me tell you the real truth about machines-they're a lot more like people than you'd think. Some are fine, some are just jerks. Rasputin? Totally right-brained. I think." -Cayde-6

title: Help
text:
Use Attunement to increase the drop chance of an item.

Gear Focusing is a great way to seek your attuned item.

Every day, a different region of Kepler is targeted. Mysteries can be reset in that region, and gear focusing uses that region's materials.

Higher World Tiers multiply all material rewards and increase chances of gear drops.

Unlock higher gear tiers by completing World Tier quests and purchasing vendor upgrades.

You need a rotating keycode to access the Bow in Banshee's workshop, but the original has been lost. You'll have to generate a new code following the same steps that Banshee did. First on Banshee's list is to get out into the field to seed a key generator with combat data.

title: INTO THE LIGHT INFORMATION
text:
• Earn BRAVE weapons by completing Arcite bounties, Onslaught weekly challenges, and sets in Onslaught, and exchanging Trophies of Bravery in the Hall of Champions.

• Collect Trophies of Bravery by completing "Into the Light" bounties, sets in Onslaught, and activities throughout the system. Onslaught activities are the best source. Trophies of Bravery can be redeemed for weapons and armor in the Hall of Champions.

• Unlock new BRAVE weapons by completing the associated quest from Arcite. Once unlocked, any "Into the Light" weapon sources will have a chance to drop that weapon. 

• Unlock the ability to attune to a weapon by completing a certain number of weapon pursuits. Attunement dramatically increases the chance for that weapon to drop from any BRAVE weapon source.

• Unlock access to armor chests and other rewards by increasing your reputation with Lord Shaxx.

title: Io Treasure Map
text: "So word is one of the Cabal's drill engineers found another one of my caches. I don't know if I did such a good job sealing it or if those dumb rhino fingers are too fat to pry it open. Anyway, it's been spotted in some hole near that drill site. I guess Ghaul called them back before they could get into it." -Cayde-6

title: Io Treasure Map
text: "Do me a favor and just look into that Pyramidion thing, would you?  If the Vex are studying the best of humanity, you know they've got stuff on me in there." -Cayde-6

title: Io Token
text: This item serves no purpose and can be safely dismantled.

title: Io Treasure Map
text: "I got word on another cache in the Echo Mesa. Some of Asher's 'assistants' chased a Legionary out of the Cabal Base but lost him in a little cave nearby. Must've left it there, since the rhino came out empty handed. That's when the assistants got him. Good thing, 'cause I'd rather it go to you." -Cayde-6

title: Io Treasure Map
text: "Gotta love the views on Io. I remember watching Jupiter float over the horizon, all big and stormy. I left a cache up there, and… fell asleep. Next thing I know, my Ghost's reviving me at the base of the cliff. Guess I roll around in my sleep." -Cayde-6

title: Io Treasure Map
text: "You know Eris Morn, right? Creepy three-eyed old Hunter, too much foundation? Doesn't matter. She comes in and asks me how Io was and I say, wrong Vanguard, ask Ikora; and she's like, I was hoping that cache by the bones marked your grave; and I'm like, I'm an Exo, I left my bones behind a long time ago; and she goes, exactly. You get anything from that?" -Cayde-6

title: Io Treasure Map
text: "When I was caught in that Vex Teleporter, I would end up in weird places. Once or twice, I swear it was Io and saw one of my own caches on top one of those tall, pointy Vex things. That's all I got for you. That 'porter was not a fun time!" -Cayde-6

title: Io Treasure Map
text: "Have you ever had a dream you're in this cave full of mist and you see this amazing cache, but every time you reach to open it, a new layer of mists blocks your path? No? Am I the only one who has this dream?" -Cayde-6

title: Io Treasure Map
text: "Funny thing, I know I've been to Io, but all the details are pretty hazy. Guess I'm getting old.  I have this memory of a battle on a bridge. Vex everywhere. After crossing a bridge, we took cover to the right, and then, well, it gets fuzzy from there. Maybe worth checking out?" -Cayde-6

title: Io Treasure Map
text: "Bear with me. I have this memory on Io where I was just sniping Vex from a ledge. Then the sky went dark, and man, I can't remember anything but pain and running and calling for an evac. I know I left something behind on that one." -Cayde-6

title: Io Treasure Map
text: "Asher called me to rant about a Taken Blight destroying a research wing of the Cabal base, and I'm like, why are you telling me? We're not friends; and then he mentions seeing one of my caches in the debris. Survived a Taken Blight. Not a bad design, if I do say so myself." -Cayde-6

title: Io Bunker Upgrades
text: Rasputin has a wide array of technology to offer as his power grows. Purchase upgrades and new tech for Io here.

title: Io Treasure Map
text: "Damn Rhinos. Made off with everything from my lockers when they ransacked the Tower. This one here, they dragged to Io and apparently left it behind. Last ping I got came from their abandoned base on the Echo Mesa." -Cayde-6

title: Io Treasure Map
text: "The lead I got from Asher was some Psion was seen making off with this one somewhere in the Echo Mesa. He mumbled something about it being on top of some Cabal checkpoint, before it-well-fell into a pit of Taken. And we all know how that turns out." -Cayde-6

title: Invading Force
text: Defeat an opposing Guardian during a Gambit match.

title: Io Treasure Map
text: "You ever talk to Banshee much? He's got this saying: Sometime the deeper you go, the less you'll ever understand. The Cabal are kind of like that. Why they feel the need to drag my stuff into their damn Io base… beyond me." -Cayde-6

title: Ionic Conductor
text: Ionic traces you create move faster and grant you additional ability energy. Nearby allies also gain ability energy when you collect an ionic trace.

title: Io Treasure Map
text: "OK, another live cache report here… Gotta give the Cabal credit. They're great at digging tunnels. Then again, so are worms… and snakes… and woodchucks… and crabs... and ants… ugh, I hate ants." -Cayde-6

title: Io Treasure Map
text: "OK, so, Albios's memorial service was on Io. Sacred to Warlocks, blah blah blah. Don't get me wrong, I liked Al-but the service ran a bit long. Ended up betting Banshee I could make a few hairy jumps high up on the Mesa. Broke both my legs, but I did it. I forget what Banshee gave me, but I know I left it in a cache up there somewhere." -Cayde-6

This item can be safely discarded at any time to stop earning Psychogenic Intel. Visit the War Table in the H.E.L.M. to recover it.

title: Legacy's Oath Bond
text: "Anastasia's obsession with Rasputin is holding back our work. Exos are our future. In time-and with a little push-she'll see." -Clovis Bray I

title: Legacy's Oath Boots
text: "My dear, sweet Lusia. You were meant to be next to me in this life, and the next. There's time yet for me to make it so." -Clovis Bray I

title: Legacy: Warmind
text:
Includes the Warmind story campaign.

Golden Age satellites slam into the surface of the Hellas Basin on Mars. Icy glaciers thaw, revealing the core of the Warmind Rasputin-and an ancient Hive army, bent on its destruction.

You can pick up this quest from Amanda Holliday in the Tower Hangar.

title: Legacy: The Red War
text:
Includes the Red War story campaign.

Humanity's Last Safe City has fallen to an overwhelming invasion force led by Dominus Ghaul, the imposing commander of the brutal Red Legion. He has stripped the City's Guardians of their power and forced the survivors to flee. You will venture to mysterious, unexplored worlds of our solar system to discover an arsenal of devastating weapons and powerful armor.

You can pick up this quest from Amanda Holliday in the Tower Hangar.

title: Legacy's Oath Cloak
text: "How would one such as myself commit Human error when I am no longer Human?" -Hari-5

title: Legacy's Oath Cowl
text: "Sylvie is a stain on this family, turning my son against me every chance she gets. His death is on her hands too." -Clovis Bray I

title: Legacy's Oath Gauntlets
text: "My path is my own. Now, and forever." -Shiro-4

title: Legacy's Oath Gloves
text: "Wilhelmina's more like me than she admits. Immortality at any cost. Even family." -Clovis Bray I

title: Legacy's Oath Greaves
text: "I've traveled far and weathered much. How far and how much, I don't know. All I know is I'm not done yet." -Micah-10

title: Legacy's Oath Grips
text: "Certainty is our greatest asset. Without it, we're nothing but shots in the dark." -Lakshmi-2

title: Legacy's Oath Helm
text: "Life's all about timing. You gotta know when to pull the trigger, when to go in for the kiss, and-most of all-when to make for the exit." -Cayde-6

title: Legacy's Oath Mark
text: "I know who I am. I am a Titan. So long as I am able, I stand between the Last City and those who would tear it down." -Saint-14

title: Legacy's Oath Mask
text: "It's not just what I'm capable of. It's how I use it that makes the difference." -Ada-1

title: Legacy's Oath Plate
text: "What is necessary and what is right are not the same. All that matters is whichever serves you best." -Lisbon-13

title: Launcher Legion
text: As a team, defeat Guardians using Grenade Launchers or Rocket Launchers. Personal final blows or multiple final blows grant bonus progress.

title: Legacy's Oath Robes
text: "Useless, that boy is. Nothing I altered in Alton's genetics paid off. Oh well. That's why I have three other grandchildren." -Clovis Bray I

title: Legacy's Oath Strides
text: "I'm more interested in where I'm going." -Banshee-44

title: Lavender Ribbon Cookies
text: Deliver these sweet and triumphant treats to Saint-14 in the Tower Hangar.

title: Legacy's Oath Vest
text: "Every day is a recommitment to my path." -Elsie Bray

title: Reysk's Last Words
text:
I released Ketch from shore. Followed tomb-road myth. Found Kell-breaker's Light-caster. I did this. None other. 

The god-steel fragment gleamed, tight-held. Felt like old stories. Felt like golden memories. Burned like mislaid countenance.

Many lost. I returned, head-sunk, pride-heavy. Fearful.

You rewarded ambitions. You did. Took Dreg and gave Vandal. Our shoulders aligned, broad.

I hunted. My prey Light-scattered to the stars. You bestowed Captain. To equal you. Beyond you, I believed. I left as Light-wielder. Hunt Light-thieves. Kill the killers.

Your warnings made true. The Light-thieves rode vengeance. They ate death. I was not enough.

Truth-speaker. Forgive. Grant me the old-bond burial. Everything, I name to you.

(You can discard this item safely.)

Ghost receives coordinates to a literal floating island somewhere off the coast of the Winding Cove in the European Dead Zone. It's been cheekily dubbed "The European Aerial Zone," and apparently it's an excellent place to perform combat drills and meditate.

Investigate the European Aerial Zone.

title: The Steel
text:
Next on the list of required components is Plasteel Plating, a durable hybrid plastic favored by Titans for its balance of strength and workability. Plasteel is not commonly available for artisan use these days: the Red War wiped out the DIY supply chain within the City.

Gather Plasteel Plating by completing bounties for Sloane on Titan, by defeating Titans in the Crucible, or by completing encounters at the Blind Well. Heroic Blind Well encounters grant the most efficient progress.

title: The Stuff of Legends
text: Speak to Drifter in the Tower to receive your next assignment in tactical City defense.

title: The Stuff of Legends
text: Finish final encounters in any raid or dungeon. Raids provide additional progress.

Osiris has asked you to enter the Sundial so that he might calibrate it to you, allowing you to move across Mercury's past and future to defeat the Cabal.

Enter the Sundial Arena playlist.

title: The Survival Guide
text:
After investigating the Drifter's Haul, you discovered he has hidden messages around the EDZ for his protégé. One of those tapes could contain the final piece of evidence that you and Aunor need to prove once and for all that the Drifter is up to no good.

Search the EDZ for Drifter's tapes. One tape can be found near computer consoles in each of the following patrol areas and Lost Sectors: Trostland, Skydock IV, Flooded Chasm, Sojourner's Camp, Excavation Site XII, Winding Cove, and Scavenger's Den.

title: The Taken Path

title: The Taken Path
text: The last Taken Osseous Fragment will give you enough signal to locate and pursue a powerful Taken energy deep within the Dreadnaught. Its touch is already upon you, and others hunt it, too. Complete the Exotic mission "Derealize" and let none stand in your way.

title: The Taken Path

title: The Temptation
text:
Want to see what this artifact can do?

Feed it Light by defeating Guardians in the Crucible. Being defeated will impede progress.

title: The Tenets
text: Investigate the monument in the Tower Courtyard.

title: The Tenets
text: Access the Tenet of Bravery to claim "The Monument" Triumph.

title: The Tenets
text: Purchase any item from the Tenet of Bravery.

title: The Tenets
text: Speak with Ikora in the Tower Bazaar.

title: The Territory War Begins
text: Gather the remaining components from around Tharsis.

title: The Territory War Begins
text:
Work your way up your Syndicate's ranks by completing a Priority Contract for your Syndicate. You may optionally complete an Invasion on the Lawless Frontier to disrupt rival Syndicates. Wager additional Deathmarks to increase rewards from successful Invasions.
 
Check the Map Guide on the Renegades Map screen to review your active Contracts.

title: The Territory War Begins
text: Your new Syndicate's leader wishes to have a word with you.

title: The Territory War Begins
text: Return to your Syndicate's den in the Cantina and deposit Dark Matter Ingots in their War Chest to increase your Reputation with them.

title: The Territory War Begins
text: Speak with your Syndicate leader to debrief on your activities on the Lawless Frontier.

title: The Territory War Begins
text:
A new day has dawned on the Lawless Frontier. Because you completed yesterday's Priority Contract, competing Syndicates will now offer you additional incentives for allying with them instead.

You may now ally with a different Syndicate for extra rewards or stay loyal to your current Syndicate and keep doing Jobs.

The choice is yours.

title: The Territory War Begins
text: Continue completing Syndicate Contracts and doing Jobs on the Lawless Frontier. At the next daily reset, your Priority Contract will reset, and you can decide to stick with your current Syndicate or ally with a new one.

title: The Territory War Begins
text:
Strengthen your ties and unlock greater rewards by reaching Rank 3 with any of the Syndicates.

Completing Contracts and depositing Dark Matter Ingots at a Syndicate's War Chest will increase your reputation with that Syndicate.

title: The Territory War Begins
text: At Rank 3, Syndicates offer you special access to a new Renegade Ability to use in the Lawless Frontier. Earn enough Credits and purchase it from the Syndicate's Quartermaster.

title: The Territory War Begins
text: Listen to the recording.

title: The Territory War Begins
text: Transmit the Prophecy from the repaired broadcaster in the Tharsis Bazaar.

title: The Territory War Begins
text: Meet with Blue at Tharsis Outpost's Ghost commune.

title: The Territory War Begins
text: Enter the Lawless Frontier and take on the Imperium presence on Europa.

title: The Territory War Begins
text: Speak to Spider in the Cantina.

title: The Territory War Begins
text:
Ally yourself to one of the Syndicates at their banner.

You will be able to change your allied Syndicate at a later time.

title: "The Tethering"
text: "The farther apart you pull two quarks, the harder they snap back."

title: The Territory War Begins
text: Speak with Lodi through your Ghost in the Tharsis Cantina.

title: "The Tethering"
text: "The farther apart you pull two quarks, the harder they snap back."

title: The Territory War Begins
text: The Syndicates are recruiting allies for the brewing territory war. Visit their quartermasters to hear their pitches and see what they have to offer.

title: The Third Test
text: Display your prowess with scout rifles. Perform kills, headshots and killing sprees with any scout rifle in the Crucible.

title: The Third Test
text: Return to the Bounty Tracker.

title: The Third Axiom
text: Equip this tier 5 weapon ornament to change the appearance of this weapon.

title: The Time-Worn Spire
text: Attune to an item to increase its drop chance from this activity. Only one item may be attuned to at a time.

title: The Third Wave
text: Complete the "In Pursuit of Honor" Glory Triumph.

title: The Time-Worn Spire
text: Equip this tier 5 weapon ornament to change the appearance of this weapon.

title: The Titanium Orchid
text: Forged in honor of Jolder, she whose grace was surpassed only by her strength in arms.

title: The Title
text: Equip this tier 5 weapon ornament to change the appearance of this weapon.

title: The Summoner
text: Purchasing this item rolls a version with random perks.

title: The Tower
text: Collect metaphysical samples from defeated combatants on the Tangled Shore. Complete strike "The Hollowed Lair."

title: The Tower Awaits
text: Make your way to the Tower in the Last City.

title: The Traitor's Die
text: Every roll of this die is already written into the fabric of Oryx's reality.

title: "The Transcendent Mind"
text: "Other orders try to learn the laws of Light. We accept that Light transcends all law."

title: "The Transcendent Mind"
text: "Other orders try to learn the laws of Light. We accept that Light transcends all law."

title: The Traveler, Alive
text:
A reward for defeating Ghaul and saving the Last City.

Contains 3 Bright Engrams, a Legendary Ghost Shell, a Legendary jumpship, 10 shaders from the Red War, and 10 Eververse Bounty Notes.

title: The Traveler, Alive (Hunter)
text:
A reward for defeating Ghaul and saving the Last City.

Contains 3 Bright Engrams, a Legendary Ghost Shell, a Legendary jumpship, 10 shaders from the Red War, and 10 Eververse Bounty Notes.

title: The Traveler, Alive (Titan)
text:
A reward for defeating Ghaul and saving the Last City.

Contains 3 Bright Engrams, a Legendary Ghost Shell, a Legendary jumpship, 10 shaders from the Red War, and 10 Eververse Bounty Notes.

title: The Traveler's Will
text: Complete the Weekly Featured Raid.

title: The Tribute Hall
text: Pay the tithe and claim your reward from Werner 99-40's chest on the Imperial Barge found on Nessus.

title: The Trolley Problem
text: Pull the lever. It's the right thing to do.

title: The Summoner
text: Attune to an item to increase its drop chance from this activity. Only one item may be attuned to at a time.

title: The True Meaning of War
text: Complete all 5 of Shaxx's weekly bounties in one week.

title: The Truth
text:
Contemplate the meaning of this card to obtain the following benefits:

• New Card: Dealing damage reduces grenade cooldown.

title: Legacy: The Truth
text: Visit the Lectern of Divination.

title: The Twins
text: Collect metaphysical samples from defeated combatants on Mars. Complete strike "Strange Terrain."

title: The Unbent Tree
text: Forged in honor of Saladin, he who bore the Banner's legacy upon his shoulders.

title: The Unclaimed Lightbearer
text:
Transmission from Osiris.

This item may be safely discarded after reading.

title: "The Unconquerable"
text: "Let's stop thinking about how to open the lock and start thinking about removing the wall."

title: Rose, Revealed
text:
The searing power of your Light burns away the sickness that consumed Dredgen Yor's Thorn, revealing the weapon that it used to be: Rose. You contemplate the weapon for a long time before resolving on a course of action. If Thorn symbolized twisted intention and malice unchecked, then you will make a gun that symbolizes something greater: the courage to choose the right path, even when it is unpopular or unsafe. But to do that, you'll need to begin your second adventure in gunsmithing.

Restore Rose's perks to prepare the gun for its future transformation.

title: Mercury Rising

Brother Vance offers quests and bounties in the Watchtower on Mercury. Find adventures, Lost Sectors, patrols, and public events as you explore the destination.

Complete the following activities on Mercury, then return to Brother Vance to collect your reward.

title: Mercury Treasure Map
text: "They just kept warping in out of nowhere. I was handling it, you know, until-you get it. Anyway, I wasn't hiding behind the waterfall. Just regrouping." -Cayde-6

title: Mercury Treasure Map
text: "Vance still won't let me in the Lighthouse! Can you believe it? Tried to hack that stupid door of his. Almost got it, too. Left some supplies behind for the next try." -Cayde-6

title: Mercury Treasure Map
text: "Is it just me, or does the Lighthouse have a lot of broken doors? Well, if no one's using them as doors, I might as well use them as stash markers." -Cayde-6

title: Mercury Treasure Map
text: "Got it in my head to scale that canyon on Mercury, the one so deep you can't see the bottom. Left a stash on a ledge near the top. Shouldn't have to go too far to find it." -Cayde-6

title: Mercury Treasure Map
text: "Good news: I left myself a note for this one. Bad news: the note just says 'live on the edge.' So… there you go." -Cayde-6

title: Mercury Treasure Map
text: "I was trying to find a back door to the Infinite Forest. First place I looked? The actual back of the Forest door. No Vex doomsday machine, but I found a good spot for a stash." -Cayde-6

title: Mercury Treasure Map
text: "So it's like a big stone ball, but it's got a fountain of radio-whatever on it. Don't look at me like that. I'm literally describing the topography." -Cayde-6

title: Mercury Treasure Map
text: "I have this feeling the Followers don't go outside much. Shame, too. If it was me, I'd be sunning myself on that patio thing they got going out there. Top-notch real estate." -Cayde-6

title: Mercury Treasure Map
text: "Was actually trying to bring the Lighthouse some supplies. You know, since Almighty ate half the planet. But Vance wouldn't let me in! Couldn't find another way in, so I just left the stash near the door… near-ish." -Cayde-6

"…all-expenses-paid trip to…"
"…series of nested pocket dimensions…"
"…where pain has no meaning…"
"…complimentary continental breakfast…"
"…transmutes flesh into a fine mist…"

On second thought, you feel as though you don't need a vacation that badly.

Guardian Games: Training or Competitive playlists and Nightfall runs at Legend or higher difficulty grant the most efficient progress.

This card can't be reacquired if abandoned.

title: Titan Treasure Map
text: "So this cache… all I remember is it's in a very… blue room. You'll know it when you see it." -Cayde-6

title: Titan Treasure Map
text: "Titan who gave me the lead said he stood there watching their spawning crud just repel off my cache… too scared to touch it. You aren't scared of a little Hive fungus are you?" -Cayde-6

title: Titan Treasure Map
text: "Reef Awoken are weird like that. She assured me it was a gold mine, so I went exploring. Check near some kind of generator machine thing, there should be one I haven't hit in years." -Cayde-6

title: Titan Treasure Map
text: "And just to amuse myself I would find natural x's in any environment and stash something somewhere beneath them, just to be able to say those words to myself… 'X marks the spot.'"

title: Titan Treasure Map
text: "We Exo must've had it made back in the Golden Age. Just my presence alone seems to bypass any active security measures in the Arcologies." -Cayde-6

title: Titan Treasure Map
text: "Those Fallen on Titan. I've been after them for years. They ransacked an old trove I kept in the Sink on Venus, then went completely dark. Getting pings on one, but everyone who's been after it gets lost in the dark way down below." -Cayde-6

title: Titan Treasure Map
text: "I take it you like to jump, right? I see the way you jump all around the Tower. Guardians these days-no respect for gravity." -Cayde-6

title: Titan Treasure Map
text: "You know what I used to love about my rest stops on Titan? Walking into the Arcology and thinking about it in its heyday. But then you get to thinking of how much we actually lost, and now the Hive just spawning everywhere… and the will to fight boils right back up." -Cayde-6

title: Titan Treasure Map
text: "OK, I actually made a sketch to remind me of this one. And it looks like I put it… near some kind of windmill. Or fan. Or something." -Cayde-6

title: Titan Treasure Map
text: "Mapping these pings to the latest from Sloane, looks like you'll be tearing through some kind of ceiling garden. Good luck with that." -Cayde-6

title: Titan Treasure Map
text: "This one is in some kind of wall. What was it with the Golden Age that they built walls around everything?" -Cayde-6

title: Titan Treasure Map
text: "Getting pings on another one somewhere high up in one of those towers. From what I hear, the Fallen are using those towers as some kind of junkyard. Could be like a needle in a haystack. Good luck." -Cayde-6

title: Titan Treasure Map
text: "I always used Titan as a rest stop before hitting the Reef. Something about those waves. This one's right under your nose. And your feet." -Cayde-6

title: Titan Treasure Map
text: "What idiot crashed the tank into the wall? It definitely, one hundred percent, absolutely wasn't me. You believe me, right?" -Cayde-6

title: Titan Treasure Map
text: "So I chased the gang of Awoken thieves up to the Arcology. That bridge didn't look too stable, and I'm not into methane baths, so I stashed what I had and picked up their trail inside." -Cayde-6

title: Tome of Dawn
text: While you have a [Solar]Solar Super equipped, aiming weapons while you're midair suspends you there for a short time. While this effect is active, you are more resistant to incoming damage and combatants are less accurate. Weapon hits extend this effect's duration, and [Solar]Solar weapon final blows provide Restoration and reload your other weapons from reserves. Provides a large benefit to the airborne effectiveness stat of all weapons.

title: Tonic Capsule
text: A tote of Eliksni make, fashioned to easily store tonics, formulae, and reagents in the field.

title: TONIC INFORMATION
text:
• Collect Common reagents by defeating combatants and collecting destination materials. Collect Uncommon, Rare, and Legendary reagents by participating in Episode: Revenant activities, or activities anywhere in the system.

• Use reagents to prepare tonics for synthesis. When the desired tonics have been prepared, complete the brewing process using the ingredients and lab equipment nearby.

• Consume brewed tonics via the Tonic Capsule in the Inventory screen. Consuming a tonic activates its effects for a limited time, allowing you to enhance your combat prowess, or earn Episode: Revenant gear.

• Discover more powerful tonic formulae by synthesizing related tonics.

title: More Than a Weapon
text:
Though you have recovered the Malahayati and Charlemagne subminds, there is much to be done before Rasputin is fully restored. 

Clovis has tasked you with the continued collection of submind data while he decrypts the launch codes you recovered from Twilight Gap.

title: More Than a Weapon
text:
With the virus successfully installed aboard Seraph Station, all that remains is to finish rebuilding Rasputin so that he can be uploaded to the Warsat network.

However, only supplemental submind data remains for reintegration into the engram. Unsatisfied with current rate of progress, Clovis seeks a more expedient way of restoring the Warmind.

text:
Despite being restored to the point where he can communicate, Rasputin still lacks the necessary code to take control of the Warsats.

He asks that you maintain your present course by retrieving submind data from Heist Battlegrounds while he assesses his current capabilities.

Ana has been monitoring his code and believes progress is continuing at a steady pace. She encourages you to keep breaching the vaults and covering more data.

Mara's discovery has called for a change in strategy. You must now hold the line against the Wrathborn without bringing the power of the Warsats to bear against them.

However, you still cannot allow Eramis to gain control of the Warsats either. Continue collecting submind data until Rasputin comes up with a new plan.

title: More Than a Weapon
text:
Despite the reintegration of the Malahayati submind, Rasputin remains incomplete. Additionally, the Warsat network's orbital hub remains inaccessible without the launch facility's authorization codes.

For now, both Clovis and Ana ask that you continue retrieving supplementary submind data while they search for another core to reintegrate into Rasputin's engram.

title: TOTALITY REPUTATION INFO
text:
Deposit Dark Matter Ingots at the Totality Division War Chest to earn Reputation with this Syndicate. Reputation unlocks access to many rewards:

• The Totality gear shop, where you can directly purchase Modified B-7 Pistol and Praxic Blade modifiers for Credits. You also receive additional gear when you increase your reputation rank.

• Renegade Abilities can be unlocked and purchased from Armorer Aghol.

• Weekly shipments, which can be increased in size based on your current Reputation.

title: Nascent Dawn 1/5
text: This module is attempting to sync to a telemetry network. Clovis Bray once had the "CB.NAV" system dedicated to collecting data for its Warminds, but it's currently fragmented beyond repair. Exposing it to the telemetry contained in Mars patrol beacons might allow the module to find what it's looking for.

title: Nascent Dawn 1/5
text: The patrol beacons have helped backfill some of the missing data, but there are some areas that Vanguard Scouts don't record for their handlers. Mapping at least one of these areas might allow the module to complete a full sync.

title: Nascent Dawn 1/5
text: You've collected enough Resonate Stems to compose an Override Frequency. These keys are a fundamental part of CB.NAV, and can access nodes for cached data. Each override is imprinted with specific telemetry data, and when you're approaching the correct node, it emits a signal for you to follow.

title: Nascent Dawn 2/5
text: The module now has full access to CB.NAV and is looking for a Sleeper Node in Ma'adim Subterrane. System logs suggest that the node is inside a natural formation.

title: Nascent Dawn 2/5
text: Return the module to Ana. She has another reward for acquiring another of her pre-Collapse logs.

title: Nascent Dawn 2/5
text: The module has stabilized with access to the Neural Net, and is now trying to sync with an unknown signal. Ana has a task for you that may allow the module to synchronize.

title: Nascent Dawn 2/5
text: The module is reacting heavily to the residual javelin energy you've been shedding since you defeated Xol. It must require access to the Rasputin Neural Net to decrypt this layer of data.

title: Nascent Dawn 3/5
text: This module requires interface with a unique node in Olympus Descent. The signal is fairly strong, meaning that the node may not be buried in an icy cavern.

title: Nascent Dawn 3/5
text: Return the module to Ana. She has another reward for acquiring another of her pre-Collapse logs.

title: Nascent Dawn 3/5
text: This iteration is looking for new data. The specific frequencies are related to the Hive. Look for areas where Rasputin has initiated the Escalation Protocol.

title: Nascent Dawn 3/5
text: The module has successfully connected to CB.NAV, but it seems to be querying for data on Vanguard initiatives. Obviously, this isn't data that CB.NAV was designed to handle. It will need to be acquired by manually spinning up strike protocols.

title: Nascent Dawn 4/5
text: After connecting to CB.NAV, the module is requesting Rasputin's Mindlab. Telemetry suggests that it's near Rasputin's doorstep.

title: Nascent Dawn 4/5
text: Return the module to Ana. She has another reward for acquiring another of her pre-Collapse logs.

title: Nascent Dawn 4/5
text: These modules have become more curious in their queries, as though there was an intelligent entity gathering data through them, testing limits and prodding at boundaries. This one is requesting telemetry on prototype weaponry through CB.NAV; it's yet another data type that the system wasn't designed to handle.

title: Nascent Dawn 4/5
text: The module is now requesting data from a Warmind Vault not located on Mars. Currently, the only accessible Vault is the one on Io.

title: Nascent Dawn 5/5
text: This module is spent. Ana will continue tinkering with it, but in return for recovering her memories, she has finished construction of what she has been calling the production-line model of the rifle prototype she gave you.

title: Nascent Dawn 5/5
text: The module requires interface with a Sleeper Node in Alton Dynamo. CB.NAV seems to be associating it with several dozen server queries.

title: Nascent Dawn 5/5
text: There is yet another layer of data within this module, requiring... a lot of log entries on the Hive. The volume of requests may require rethinking normal scouting protocols. Perhaps disrupting a major ritual is in order.

title: Nascent Dawn 5/5
text: The module has stabilized, but its queries have immediately become more suspicious. It has begun requesting entries on Guardian combat patterns: kills, deaths, resurrections, everything.

title: Nascent Dawn 5/5
text: This module requires stabilization from the Rasputin Neural Net. Using the Valkyrie will open up the next layer of data.

title: Transcendence
text:
Achieve harmony by dealing damage with Light and Dark damage types in equal measure or by applying subclass buffs to your allies. Kinetic damage generates both Light and Dark energy.

While Transcendence is active, your grenade is replaced by a unique Prismatic grenade that deals both Light and Dark damage. Dealing melee damage while transcendent greatly increases your grenade energy regeneration, and vice versa. Defeating targets while transcendent extends its duration.

title: Transcendent Blessing
text: This mod has been deprecated and no longer functions. You may replace it with another mod.

text: "One point, I thought I'd broken free, so I made a break for a path through a tangle of roots. Caught sight of the cache and then bam, I was back in the loop again." -Cayde-6

text: "It was like I was being called closer, like something wanted my help. Then I get to this tower with a triangular doorway and go through. That's when it got really weird." -Cayde-6

title: Nessus Treasure Map
text: "I don't know what they call it. The eyeball thing. Under that. You'll know it when you see it." -Cayde-6

title: Nessus Treasure Map
text: "I wonder if the Vex even realize I hide stuff between the gaps in their block networks. Hmmm. Maybe that's how they know so much about me." -Cayde-6

title: Nessus Treasure Map
text: "Good news: I left myself a reminder note for this cache! Bad news: the note says 'Whatever you do, under any circumstances, do not look down.' That's enough to go on, right?"

title: Nessus Treasure Map
text: "So there I was, two choices: I could've tried climbing the red ivy, or just jump. What do you think I did?" -Cayde-6

title: Nessus Treasure Map
text: "I had no choice. Once I saw the floating rocks, there was no way I was going to weigh myself down with extra gear. I was Lightless after all, remember?" -Cayde-6

title: Nessus Treasure Map
text: "I should've realized something was up when the Vex were letting me move through portals so freely. And I usually have a good nose for traps. Maybe you'll have better luck?" -Cayde-6

title: Nessus Treasure Map
text: "I felt bad using their wreckage to hide my stuff, but Failsafe said it was cool. And she says she's been keeping the Vex from converting the Exodus Black, so I figured it would be safe." -Cayde-6

title: Nessus Treasure Map
text: "So this cache… I don't know. It seemed like a good idea at the time. How do you feel about climbing trees?" -Cayde-6

title: Nessus Treasure Map
text: "So down I went. I thought maybe the deeper it got, the better access I would have to their core Mind or Nexus points. I do read Ikora's Vex reports. Sometimes. Anyway, found nothing but roots." -Cayde-6

title: Nessus Treasure Map
text: "I guess I was afraid that Mind juice would somehow seize control of my weapons or something. That stuff isn't some kind of luxurious milk bath, trust me." -Cayde-6

title: Nessus Treasure Map
text: "I was just doing what Failsafe said. I mean, she seems reliable, half the time. So I entered this cave and set up my little fallback point, took a few steps in, and bam, the battle began." -Cayde-6

title: Node 1
text:
there are banners of dissolution
in a place fit for filth
lost to the sun, lost to the stars
within our unclaimed un-home
east of the devils' raze

so find the cavern, see with four eyes
this is the hearth our leaders claim
rust, rot, wet, dark-
a metal nursery, a metal brood
what a future we build!

-transl. from Eliksni

title: Node 2
text:
now to the grave of the drained captain
find his spoils
six lives, stripped and spiked
a warning to no one
see how low we stoop

-transl. from Eliksni

title: Node 3
text:
now leave the squalor
northeast to your archon's ruins
descend into the belly, deep below
find the nest, the untouched rations
behold the legacy of your people

-transl. from Eliksni

title: Node 4
text:
now ascend, wander, think
two people both traveler-chosen
two people both ruins-living
two people both widow-making
with lost leaders and uncertain futures
together, we could be more than we are

-transl. from Eliksni

title: Nightmask Cloak
text: "They say the Crucible is preparation for the frontier. I see it the other way around." - Ain Suhu-ässä

title: Node 5
text:
now go, take to the stars
you, as we, were once wayfarers
you, as we, built lives around machines
but your symbiosis was different
you chose your people to be reborn

-transl. from Eliksni

no great leader imagines salvage as birthright
surely you must understand my heart

title: Two's Company

title: Tying It All Together
text: Speak with Ada-1 in the Tower to receive starter materials for Armor Synthesis.

title: Tying It All Together
text: Use the Synthweave that Ada provided to create an ornament from any piece of Legendary armor you've acquired.

title: Tying It All Together
text: Purchase any Armor Synthesis bounty from Ada-1.

title: Tying It All Together
text: Complete any Armor Synthesis bounty and claim its reward.

title: Tying It All Together
text: Return to Ada-1 in the Tower to discuss your progress.

title: Tying It All Together
text: Return to Ada-1 in the Tower Armory and report your successful operation of the Loom.

title: Tying It All Together
text: Acquire 10,000 Glimmer in order to purchase another Armor Synthesis bounty from Ada-1.

title: Tying It All Together
text: Return to Ada-1 to continue manufacturing Synthweave.

title: Type-II Powerplant
text: A spaceflight-rated powerplant requisitioned from a City shipyard.

title: Twilight Arsenal
text:
[Super]  : Summon three Void axes and throw them at your foes one after another. On impact, the axes pull in nearby targets and detonate in a weakening explosion. After exploding, the axes can be picked up by you or your allies and used as a weapon for a short time.

While carrying a Void axe:
[Light Attack]  : Slash forward with your axe, dealing damage and weakening targets.
[Heavy Attack]  : Throw the axe, consuming all remaining ammo.

title: Tyra Karn
text: Tyra - another Guardian who has lost her connection to the Light - has a warning about the Shard from your vision.

title: Umbral Activities
text: Completing raids, dungeons, Dares of Eternity, and non-Seasonal playlist activities has a chance to reward Seraphic Umbral Energy.

title: Ultrasonic Vest
text: Equip this ornament on any eligible Legendary armor item to change its appearance. Once you get a universal ornament, it's unlocked for all characters of the relevant class on your account.

title: Umbral Binding
text: Binding at the end of Nightmare Containment rewards additional Opulent Umbral Energy.

title: Umbral Contender
text: Land Void or Strand final blows in strikes. Higher strike scores and defeating combatants with melee abilities and finishers grants additional progress. Completing a strike grants significantly more progress.

title: Ultraviolet
text: Equip this weapon ornament to change the appearance of Borealis. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.

title: Electric Contender
text: Land Arc final blows or final blows with the Prismatic subclass equipped in Guardian Games Rushdown or strikes. Higher Rushdown scores and defeating combatants with melee abilities or finishers grants additional progress.

title: Umbral Decryption
text: Access the Umbral Decoder and decrypt an Umbral Engram.

title: Umbral Contender
text:
Get Void or Stasis final blows in Guardian Games and Vanguard playlists. Higher scores as well as melee and finisher final blows grant additional progress. Completing a strike or Battleground grants massively increased progress.

This card can't be reacquired if abandoned.

title: Umbral Discovery II
text: Increase the Umbral discovery bonus to 2 times a day.

title: Umbral Discovery I
text: Once a day, earn a bonus Umbral Engram by completing a playlist strike, Nightfall: The Ordeal, Crucible or Gambit match, dungeon, raid, or Menagerie activity.

title: Umbral Echo
text: Decoding focused Seasonal weapons has a small chance to refund Risen Umbral Energy.

title: Umbral Energy Chests
text: Haunted Alcove Chests and Opulent Chests have a chance to reward Opulent Umbral Energy.

title: Umbral Discovery III
text: Increase the Umbral discovery bonus to 3 times a day.

title: Umbral Engram
text: A mysterious engram that contains a wide variety of Legendary gear. Its contents are susceptible to influence.

title: Umbral Engram
text: A mysterious engram that contains a wide variety of Legendary gear. Its contents are susceptible to influence.

title: Umbral Energy Requisition
text: Completing raids, dungeons, and non-Seasonal playlist activities has a chance to grant Risen Umbral Energy.

title: Umbral Engram
text:
A mysterious engram containing a wide variety of Legendary gear. Its contents are susceptible to influence.

Visit Rahool in the Tower to decrypt its basic form. Focusing it via the Star Chart in the H.E.L.M. will allow you to choose from a variety of rewards.

title: Umbral Engram
text: Bring the mysterious Umbral Engram to the Drifter, located in the Annex of the Tower.

title: Umbral Engram
text: A mysterious engram containing a wide variety of Legendary gear. Its contents are susceptible to influence. Rahool in the Tower can decrypt its basic form, but vendors in the H.E.L.M. can unlock its deeper secrets.

title: Umbral Enhancement I
text:
Unlocks basic Umbral Focusing capabilities for the Prismatic Recaster.

Season of Arrivals Pass owners unlock new seasonal Legendary weapons from Umbral Engrams and have access to Pyramid-Focused Umbral Engrams under basic Umbral Focusing.

title: Umbral Enhancement II
text: The Prismatic Recaster influences the behavior of Umbral Engrams and Twisted Energy. Decrypting any Umbral Engram now provides shaders, and unfocused Umbral Engrams gain a low chance to award Exotic gear. Earning Twisted Energy immediately injects it into the Prismatic Recaster.

title: Notorious Staff
text: Your reward for reaching maximum clan level in Season 6.

title: Nougat Delight
text: Equip this shader to change the color of your gear.

title: Nouveau Filigree
text: Equip this armor ornament to change the appearance of Necrotic Grip. Once you get an ornament, it's unlocked for all characters on your account.

title: Noisy Horn
text:
Very distracting.
Once equipped, press  to sound your horn.

title: Nova Bomb: Cataclysm
text:
Hurl an explosive bolt of Void Light at a target, disintegrating those caught within its blast.

Nova Bomb travels slowly and seeks targets. Detonations shatter into smaller seeker projectiles.

title: Nova Bomb: Cataclysm
text:
Hurl an explosive bolt of Void Light at a target, disintegrating those caught within its blast.

Nova Bomb travels slowly and seeks targets. Detonations shatter into smaller seeker projectiles.

title: Nova Bomb: Vortex
text:
Hurl an explosive bolt of Void Light at a target, disintegrating those caught within its blast.

Nova Bomb creates a singularity that pulls targets inward and continually damages those trapped inside.

title: Nova Mortis
text: "From the space between I come. Fragments of stars burn in my footsteps. In my hands I hold Death." -Song of the Nova Mortis

title: Nova Pulse
text: [Finisher]  : Finish critically wounded combatants.

title: Nova to Run, Nova to Hide
text: Defeat combatants in the European Aerial Zone using Void subclass abilities.

title: Nova Turning Back
text: Complete Heroic public events with a Void subclass equipped.

title: Nova Warp
text:
Step between dimensions to subvert the laws of physics.

[Super Secondary]  : Teleport a short distance and release weakening seekers.

[Super Primary]  : Unleash a deadly Void eruption. A fully charged attack makes targets volatile.

title: Novel Data
text: Complete a weekly bounty for Asher to help him study the Pyramid.

title: Novgorod Cloak
text: "A Hunter back from a quest? Now that's the best storyteller in the galaxy." -Cayde-6

title: Nox Acror IV
text: It is an unbinding, a tearing, a siphoning. That is the power of your hand.

title: Nox Astur III
text: Let your mind be fleet and subtle as the night-soaring hawk.

title: Nox Cantor II
text: Directed energy weapon with a short charge cycle. The NCII is a multirole design that feeds on hydrogen isotope reactant.

title: Nox Cantor III
text: The well-balanced NCIII fusion rifle balances power with ease of manufacture.

title: Nox Inergia IV

title: Nox Perennial V

title: Nox Praeli III

title: Nox Revus III

title: Nox Umber I
text: The red sunset heralds the long, dark night.

title: PIKERS REPUTATION INFO
text:
Deposit Dark Matter Ingots at the Pikers War Chest to earn Reputation with this Syndicate. Reputation unlocks access to many rewards:

• The Pikers gear shop, where you can directly purchase Refurbished A499 and Praxic Blade modifiers for Credits. You also receive additional gear when you increase your reputation rank.

• Renegade Abilities can be unlocked and purchased from Mechanic Deoriks.

• Weekly shipments, which can be increased in size based on your current Reputation.

title: Specimen ID: NES005
text:
Failsafe is concerned that this specimen looks hungry and has run an analysis of its dietary needs.

Collect Iridescent Radiolite to find nutritional clusters within. Failsafe calls these clusters "Bufo Bites," and believes they mirror the animal's natural food source.

title: Specimen ID: NES005
text:
To keep this specimen happy, healthy, and enriched, it will need a natural habitat.

Collect flora from Nessus to prepare a small terrarium in the H.E.L.M.

title: Specimen ID: NES005
text:
The H.E.L.M. doesn't have room for more than one specimen. That doesn't mean its species should go unprotected.

Defeat Vex on Nessus to ensure a safe habitat.

title: Specimen ID: NES006
text:
This specimen is a Vex weapon of some kind. However, it is as yet impossible to pinpoint what kind of Vex wielded it.

Defeat combatants with Sidearms or Auto Rifles to narrow down the weapon's projectile type. Defeating other Guardians grants bonus progress.

title: Specimen ID: NES005
text: Speak with Failsafe in the H.E.L.M. to review her final specimen analysis report.

title: Specimen ID: NES006
text:
The weapon is calibrated to do medium amounts of damage. The next step to narrowing down its source is identifying its damage type.

Defeat combatants with Arc or Solar damage to provide a signature reading. Defeating other Guardians grants bonus progress.

title: Specimen ID: NES005
text: Give Captain Jacobson a new home in the H.E.L.M.

title: Specimen ID: NES006
text:
The specimen appears to deal Arc damage through a modified power source.

Generate Orbs of Power to generate some potential comparison data for Failsafe to study. Orbs generated in Crucible or Gambit generate bonus progress.

title: Specimen ID: NES007
text:
Secure the data Failsafe needs by completing Echoes Encore, Echoes Battlegrounds, or collecting Extracted Data in the Breach Executable activity from the H.E.L.M.

This prototype was enhanced with manipulated data to expand its memory. Failsafe requires more ambient data from interactions with Vex to continue her work.

title: Specimen ID: NES007
text:
The specimen has been manipulated in unexpectedly complex ways. Failsafe has run out of data to compare it to, and could use a fresh batch.

Rapidly defeat Vex to acquire a large sampling of their CPUs.

text:
These CPUs are emitting a control sequence. They require proximity to other Vex in order to expose the access protocols.

Launch and complete an Echoes Battleground from the H.E.L.M. to provide Failsafe access to the CPU protocols.

text:

Test this control in the Exotic mission "Encore" launched from the H.E.L.M. and defeating Vex with Void or Arc damage. Using [Void] Volatile or [Arc] Blind awards bonus progress.

Bring them back some comfortable branches from the treetops of Nessus.

title: Specimen ID: NES009

title: Lost Memory Fragment
text:
25 DAYS UNTIL DIVERGENCE

As an engineer, I wish I could bottle inspiration. You never know when it'll hit. For instance, this morning I was servicing some Hephaestus Field Units, test nodes that are meant to gauge weapon effectiveness in a variety of field conditions, and I had an idea. The nodes are mobile enough that they could be easily hidden, and reconfigured to need specific weapon data to activate. If someone is smart enough, they could easily arrange the nodes to serve as a locking mechanism, one that's hidden right in plain view.

This item may be safely discarded.

title: Lost Memory Fragment
text:
12 DAYS UNTIL DIVERGENCE

Jumping into an Einstein-Rosen bridge to travel in time has long been regarded fantasy by serious physicists. But what if there existed a computer so powerful it could indistinguishably simulate an entire alternate timeline? Based on my early research, this is a possibility of Vex technology. The key question would be whether one could take knowledge from a simulated timeline and alter the original. One step at a time, though.

This item may be safely discarded.

title: Lost Memory Fragment
text:
2 DAYS UNTIL DIVERGENCE

I'm out of time. All I've got to hold on to is the hope that I've moved enough of my tech into the vaults, and that the visions of the future I've seen are accurate. That somehow, divorced from time and space, my words find you. Please tell Ana I'm sorry, and that I never wanted her to be dragged into this. You were smart enough to break my code, so I'll put my trust in you to use what I've created to make things right. One day this will all make sense, I promise.

This item may be safely discarded.

title: Lost Memory Fragment
text:
21 DAYS UNTIL DIVERGENCE

A brilliant classmate I met at the physics fellowship in Delhi took a job on Venus to continue her research. Twice a year we exchange encrypted transmissions to share ideas, for it's a silly notion to lay claim to shared human knowledge. Ishtar Academy materials are forbidden on Mars, but I avail myself of any opportunity to push myself to the next peak. If I can get my hands on a Vex Core, there's no telling how far I can push Bray engineering.

This item may be safely discarded.

title: Lost Memory Fragment
text:
3 DAYS UNTIL DIVERGENCE

If I'm gone that means something terrible has happened to me. I've wiped all traces of my research, but Willa has security scouring the facility for me. She wants to take the weapon I've created, and at this point it's impossible to take it offworld. It's way too dangerous to fall into wrong hands so my only choice is to hide it… The old storage caches in Core Terminus and Olympus Descent are now linked to the Hephaestus test network.

This item may be safely discarded.

title: The Edge of Fate Campaign Skip Boost
text:
Auto-completes The Edge of Fate campaign and grants associated rewards, including all Kepler abilities earned by your most advanced character.

Additionally, gives immediate access to Fabled and Mythic world tiers, the Sieve activity, and a set of armor for the character's class. Armor is acquired at the Power level equivalent to your most advanced character.

title: The Essence
text:
Banshee has recommended a number of rare components that you should be able to use to restore your ruined Thorn to working order. First on the list is Hadronic Essence, a dense lattice of exotic baryons and mesons, once commonly favored as an infusion in Warlock fieldweave.

Gather Hadronic Essence by completing bounties for Asher Mir on Io, by defeating Warlocks in the Crucible, or by completing Nightfall strikes. Nightfall strikes grant the most efficient progress.
